title: Design: the grayed Edit and the link on a shared matrix
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, pricing a new category made for this test, category A, and a second new category made for this test, category B.
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
custom_steps:
1. Open Settings › Categories.
  2. Click category A's row.
  3. Point at the grayed Edit.
  4. Click the "Go to the" link.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Categories list shows.

Step 2:

  • Edit above the grid is grayed, and a blue link beside it reads "Go to the", matrix A's name and "matrix", as in picture 7.9.

Step 3:

  • A dark tooltip below the button reads "Can't edit here. The", matrix A's name, "matrix prices 2 categories, so edit it from the matrix."
  • Its position matches picture 7.10.

Step 4:

  • Matrix A's page opens in edit; the breadcrumb reads Categories › category A's name › matrix A's name.
  • Cancel and a blue Save sit above the grid, and the simulator shows below it, as in picture 7.11.
